title: Staff Software Engineer - Storage I/O
description: P-1325 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Storage & IO team builds foundational systems that enable Databricks workloads to access cloud data efficiently and reliably. The team owns cloud storage clients and connectors across platforms including Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake, and Google Cloud Storage, as well as data caching, storage scheduling, and key Parquet components. Engineers on this team work on low-level backend and distributed-systems problems that directly impact storage performance, stability, and observability across the platform. The Impact You Will Have Design and build high-performance storage systems that enable efficient and reliable data access across multi-cloud environments. Own the technical strategy and implementation of critical storage infrastructure components from design through production. Drive improvements to storage performance and reliability, with particular focus on reducing cold start and cold read latency for analytics and BI workloads. Lead cross-team technical initiatives to improve observability, scalability, and operational excellence of storage systems. Make architectural decisions that balance performance, reliability, and maintainability across complex distributed systems. Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for storage and distributed systems engineering across the organization. What We Look For 8+ years of software engineering experience. Deep experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage systems in production environments. Strong systems programming skills with experience in languages including Java, Scala, C++, or Go. Proven track record of leading complex technical projects that span multiple teams or system boundaries. Experience optimizing performance and reliability of storage systems, including work with cloud storage platforms or distributed file systems. Ability to influence technical direction through strong technical judgment, clear communication, and collaboration across engineering teams. B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
